entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Sir Colin Muir Barber, was a senior British Army officer who fought in both the First and Second World Wars, where he commanded the 15th (Scottish) Infantry Division across Northwest Europe from August 1944 until Victory in Europe Day in May 1945. Barber was reputed to be the tallest officer in the British Army, and thus earned the ironic nickname "Tiny".
